record_scope_definition: Each complete function range is pinned to the original library. The scope and unimplemented caller policies are stated per function and in NOTES.md.
source_reconstruction_scope: Character::GetRespawnDelay signed conversion and Character::CanRespawn outer suppression/property gates, delegating the optional GroupInfo leaf to the existing character_group_respawn kernel. No native property storage, actor/group ownership, or timer policy is reconstructed.
caller_facts: Character+0x1481 is checked before property access by both outer methods; Character::InitSpawned sets this byte to 1, so the adapter preserves it as a raw nonzero/zero suppression fact without inventing a member name.

The queried CharacterProperties field is ID 11, RespawnTime. CanRespawn checks its raw signed value > 0; GetRespawnDelay independently converts the raw value by arithmetic shift right 8 then multiply by 1000.
A null Character+0x3fc GroupInfo pointer makes CanRespawn return true after the byte/property gates. A non-null pointer delegates to GroupInfo::CanRespawn(Character*) with Character state ID.
The port uses a property-ID callback and passes 11 only after the source suppression gate. It binds character_group::can_respawn directly; it does not duplicate that leaf.

Port input protection validates the caller's outer output against group header and consumed member storage; the leaf receives a local result and cannot see those aliases. Header checks do not dereference the group. Member checks run only for state 3/status 1, retain the leaf's no-read branches, and reject address-space wrap before member queries.
unsupported: The live Character property sheet, property recalculation pipeline and source object layout are caller-owned; this adapter accepts a raw resolved value through a callback.
GroupInfo construction, membership storage, member lifetime, OnDied/OnEnemySpotted status producers, and native group ownership are not implemented.
CSLimbus::OnFocus timer eligibility and PlayerManager local-host policy, timer event 0x2f delivery, and native Character coordinator wiring are deliberately deferred.
The source byte at Character+0x1481 is not semantically renamed beyond the observed InitSpawned suppression behavior.
